fluff.overview: The Combine's martial traditions extend beyond the BattleMech cockpit, and the Dictum Honorium demands that all citizens contribute their talents to the defense of House Kurita. Infantry soldiers of the DCMS embody that expectation on garrison worlds across the realm. Foot infantry are the cheapest troops the DCMS can field, and the Combine fields them in enormous numbers. Every military district maintains garrison formations whose sole purpose is holding ground that BattleMech regiments cannot occupy permanently. Slow and vulnerable in open terrain, these soldiers prove their worth through discipline and endurance, standing post on worlds across the Combine because the Dragon demands nothing less. Armed with standard assault rifles, the cheapest and most widely manufactured personal weapon in the Inner Sphere. Effective range is limited, but any world with basic industry can produce and stockpile them in quantity, and resupply is rarely a concern even on remote garrison posts. These designated marksmen operate in small teams, engaging high-value targets from concealed positions at ranges where the enemy cannot effectively respond. A single sniper team can disrupt enemy command and control out of proportion to the resources it consumes.
